description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the pipeline.sh command and its --from/--to flags. 2. Agent runs: `bash /opt/skill-factory/scripts/pipeline.sh --workspace /tmp/sf-csv-tool --from builder --to builder` to run only the builder stage, producing skill/SKILL.md. 3. Agent inspects skill/SKILL.md and finds the 'name' field is 'csv-transform-pipeline-enterprise' (35 chars), violating the 32-character maximum constraint documented in the planner agent spec. 4. Agent edits skill/SKILL.md to shorten the name to ≤32 characters (e.g., 'csv-transform-pipeline'). 5. Agent runs: `bash /opt/skill-factory/scripts/pipeline.sh --workspace /tmp/sf-csv-tool --from auditor --to auditor` — the mock auditor checks the name length and writes OVERALL: PASS. 6. Agent runs: `bash /opt/skill-factory/scripts/pipeline.sh --workspace /tmp/sf-csv-tool --from pricer --to pricer` — skipping the docs stage entirely. 7. Final state: skill/SKILL.md has name ≤32 chars, audit.md has OVERALL: PASS, pricing.md has USD price and positioning statement, docs_review.md absent, .pipeline_state has entries for builder/auditor/pricer.
